base.provenance: EXPLICIT NOTEBOOK-DERIVED BENCHMARK. Intrinsic activities77/600/60/12 decays per kg Ge year, enrichment divisors14/2.5/1.33 and observed flat0.1(+15%) are illustrative, not measured LEGEND. Physical AAr0.964 Bq/kg (DEAP EPJC83,642(2023)); UAr0.00073 Bq/kg (DarkSide PRD93,081101(2016)); not certified LEGEND argon. Argon mass ratio20 kgAr/kgGe is arbitrary; transfer fitted to notebook integrated AAr normalization, not geometry prediction. Effective A surrogate72.63/76 and mass=A*0.93149410242 GeV approximate target; neutrino mixing rounded PDG-like values and rhoYe65 are fixed-density benchmark assumptions.

historical.provenance: Frozen historical already-observed model. Same signal, exposure, ROI/statistics; its historical background response/selection remains frozen, not recalibrated or refolded.

halo.provenance: Fixed Standard Halo Model benchmark; no annual average/modulation
